title: rosa pendulina var. intermedia
intro: Rosa pendulina var. intermedia, commonly known as Sweet Briar, is a hybrid plant species that combines the characteristics of Rosa pendulina and Rosa rubiginosa. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Rosa pendulina var. intermedia include wound healing, soothing skin irritations, and possibly alleviating anxiety and depression due to its sedative effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and volatile oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
